## About
A-Team Automotive Repair is a full service auto repair shop on Collins Road, serving Sunnyvale and the surrounding areas. We work on brakes, steering, suspension, transmissions, engines, air conditioning and the scheduled maintenance that keeps your car on the road.
Our technicians have the training to diagnose and complete a broad range of auto services, big jobs and small ones. We listen to what you need and what you think, so we can guide you toward a repair that fits your car and your budget.
We're rated 4.5 on Google from 154 reviews. Give us a call and let us take a look at your car.

## Services
- Scheduled maintenance: Factory recommended maintenance including oil changes, belts, hoses, cooling system service, brake checks, power steering service, and tire balance and rotation.
- Brakes, shocks and struts: Brake pads, rotors, calipers, master cylinders, brake lines and brake fluid, along with shocks and struts.
- Computer diagnostics: We check the onboard systems that flag drivability, air bag, engine, transmission and body function problems.
- Transmission replacement and repair: Transmission overhauls, replacement with a refurbished or used unit, and manual transmission repair.
- Engine replacement and repair: Cylinder head repair, used engine replacement, crate motors and more.
- Air conditioning repair and service: We evacuate and recharge AC systems, diagnose AC concerns, and replace condensers, expansion valves, compressors and controls.
- Engine cooling system repairs and service: Pressure and leak testing, plus water pump, radiator, thermostat, heater core and heater hose replacement.
- State inspections: Bring your car in for its state inspection.
- Pre purchase inspections: Have us look over a car before you buy it.

## FAQ
Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Call us at 972-203-3599 or send an email to ateamauto@sbcglobal.net. For anything urgent, calling is best.

Q: What are your hours at the end of the week?
A: Saturday we're open from 7:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Sunday we're closed.

Q: Do you work on manual transmissions?
A: Yes. We repair manual transmissions and replace clutches, slave cylinders, master cylinders and throw out bearings.
